name: glanceflow
description: A plain-English checklist above the prompt for Claude Code. Requires Claude Code; it does not run in Codex. This manifest only carries the listing links registries read.

interface.shortDescription: See what Claude Code is doing, at a glance (Claude Code only)
interface.longDescription: GlanceFlow is a mod for Claude Code, not Codex. It replaces the wall of tool calls with one plain-English checklist above the prompt: the plan, live progress, whether changed code was tested, when Claude needs you, history and a team report. Install it in Claude Code with /plugin marketplace add Antreas-Strb/glanceflow.
